_comment: Microsoft Entra ID application registration template for the Claude gateway API.
Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. Every GUID marked GENERATE-NEW must be a fresh
The well-known GUIDs below are Microsoft first-party constants, identical in
every tenant, and must be used verbatim:
Remove this _comment key before submitting to Microsoft Graph.
_comment_groups: ApplicationGroup emits ONLY the groups assigned to this application in the
`groups` claim. This is deliberate: it is the mitigation for groups overage.
If a user is in more than ~200 groups and you use 'SecurityGroup' or 'All',
Entra drops the groups claim entirely and substitutes _claim_names /
_claim_sources, which the APIM quota policy cannot read -> every user gets 403.

_comment_tokenversion: 2 => aud is the bare app id GUID, iss is https://login.microsoftonline.com/<TENANT_ID>/v2.0
1 => aud is api://<GATEWAY_APP_ID>,   iss is https://sts.windows.net/<TENANT_ID>/
Whichever you pick, the APIM <audiences> list must match. Listing both
api://<GATEWAY_APP_ID> and the bare GUID is the resilient choice.
The Claude Desktop oidc.issuer value must match this too.

oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDisplayName: Access the Claude gateway as the signed-in user
oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDescription: Allows the app to call the Claude gateway API on behalf of the signed-in user, embedding their group membership in the access token.
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDisplayName: Access the Claude gateway on your behalf
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDescription: Allows the app to call the Claude gateway API as you.

_comment_preauth: Pre-authorizing the Azure CLI lets `az account get-access-token --scope
api://<GATEWAY_APP_ID>/access_as_user` succeed without a separate consent
prompt. This is what makes the Claude Code apiKeyHelper script work.
delegatedPermissionIds must contain the access_as_user scope id above.

_comment_approles: App roles exist so that security GROUPS can be assigned to the application,
which is what makes ApplicationGroup emit those groups in the `groups` claim.
Assigning a group (rather than a user) to an app role requires Entra ID P1 or P2.
The APIM quota policy does NOT match on these role ids. It matches the
GROUP OBJECT IDs that land in the `groups` claim. Record those separately
_comment_publicclient: isFallbackPublicClient=true marks this as a public client so CLI / desktop
auth-code + PKCE flows work without a client secret.
Claude Desktop's browser auth flow needs a loopback redirect URI.
_comment_spa: Only needed if you enable the APIM developer portal OAuth sign-in.
Drop this block entirely if you are not using the developer portal.
